svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leg: cut 269 mm of 25 x 2 mm tube; round the top end; drill 8.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across, 10 mm from the top (pivot), and 6.5 mm 30 mm below it (detent).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot: 50 x 50 x 4 mm plate with a 28 x 30 mm stake tab on one side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (11 mm hole, 15 mm from the plate edge); weld square to the leg.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The tab points toward the nearer end of the cart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bracket: bend a 3 mm aluminium strip into a U, 26 mm inside,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: legs 29 mm, web 45 mm long; 8.5 mm pivot hole through both legs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: rivet the web under the wing's outer long member, 80 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the frame end; M8 pivot bolt, nyloc nut, snug.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leg down: vertical with the wing at 15 degrees. Folded: flat under

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the wing, 7 mm clear of the frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the wing's outer edge sits 309 mm above the ground.
